// WHO AM I

About Me

I'm a Java Backend Developer with hands-on experience in building scalable backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs. I have completed my MCA from Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and my BCA from Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University.

With professional experience at Aryson Technologies, I have worked on real-world enterprise applications — including Microsoft Graph API integration, duplicate data processing, OAuth 2.0 authentication, and cloud-based OneDrive file management handling 10,000+ files per scan.

I focus on clean, maintainable code with strong foundations in OOP, Data Structures & Algorithms, and database management. I also craft responsive frontends using Thymeleaf, Bootstrap, and HTML/CSS/JS.

Beyond work, I actively sharpen my problem-solving skills — having solved 100+ problems each on LeetCode and GeeksforGeeks.
